title: OmniVChat: Synthesizing, Benchmarking, and Training for Native Audio-Visual Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2609.21465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We define OmniVChat (Omni Video Chat) as the task of native audio-visual dialogue between a user and an omni model. In OmniVChat, omni models directly and simultaneously receive audio and video from a user and return text. The user's query is embedded in the audio and video, without a separate text question, external captioning, or speech recognition. Direct audio-visual input reduces external latency and computation while preserving perceptual cues. However, research on OmniVChat faces two constraints: data availability and evaluation. Recordings of people using their own devices are scarce. Furthermore, a good reply often needs to account for the user's surroundings, facial expressions, and nearby objects, and such responses can be expressed in many different ways, making keyword matching unreliable for evaluating reply quality. translated_title: OmniVChat：面向原生音视频对话的合成、基准测试与训练

tldr: 提出了 OmniVChat 这一原生音视频对话新任务，全模态模型直接同时接收用户的音频和视频并返回文本，无需文本问题、外部字幕或语音识别，并针对数据稀缺与评估困难两大挑战提出了合成、基准测试与训练的完整解决方案。
en_tdlr: OmniVChat introduces a native audio-visual dialogue task where omni models directly receive simultaneous audio and video input from users without text questions, external captioning, or speech recognition, addressing data scarcity and evaluation challenges through a complete pipeline of synthesis, benchmarking, and training.
